Unit tests for txn cache creation, join, insert, query, and root advance.

# Purpose
This file is a unit test program for the `fd_txncache` component. It checks the creation, join, and use of the transaction cache shared-memory object and the local cache object. The tests verify error handling for invalid arguments, then create a cache, attach forks, insert transaction hashes for block hashes, finalize forks, and query the cache to confirm that stored entries can be found and missing entries are rejected.

The file also tests root advancement across many fork generations. In [`test_advance_root`](<#test_advance_root>), it creates a chain of child forks, inserts one transaction per block, finalizes each fork, and calls `fd_txncache_advance_root` to move the cache root forward. The [`main`](<#main>) function sets up scratch memory, computes the required footprints with `fd_txncache_shmem_footprint` and `fd_txncache_footprint`, runs the test cases, and exits after printing `pass`.
